Who can read each page, from the page access rules. A rule applies to its page and every page below it. With no Restrict Read rule on the way down, anyone can open a page. A user needs one role of every Restrict Read rule on the way down. A Grant Change role can read its whole branch, whatever Restrict Read says. The Anonymous Users role in a rule lets nobody in. Each page stands for all its language versions.
